title: 第 86 章青璇离去陆成相救凌雪瑶第85章青璇主动脱衣强迫陆成
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙：我让高冷女宗主孕气十足！第86章青璇离去，陆成相救凌雪瑶（..la）宫殿内画面突然变得不可描述起来！
画面简直不要太美！
陆成望着青璇那炙热的美目，脑瓜子稳稳的。
什么情况？
青璇为何会变成了这幅模样？
难道是那洛玉青留下的手段？
陆成心中惊起一片寒意。
这洛玉青真是好狠的手段啊！
镇压封印青璇一万年，覆灭尸阴宗，夺走尸阴宗圣物。
如今青璇刚刚脱困，竟然还使用如此卑鄙下三滥的手段，简直就是一个畜生啊！
而且听方才洛玉青的描述，那掌天鼎的三妹碎片还是洛玉青故意放在此处。
并且还镇压了他的爱人。
难道这一切，都是洛玉青故意为之？
陆成眼神冰冷。
但此刻，他也无下多想，因为青璇的朱唇已经印在了陆成的嘴巴上。
三个小时之后。
青璇双目空洞的望着天空，而陆成则是不敢说话，小心翼翼的穿好衣服。
青璇穿好衣服，眼神复杂的看向陆成。
杀还是不杀？
她的内心并不平静。

自己不久前发过誓言，可是刚才这个小辈玷污了她的身子。
可是转眼一想，是自己主动为之。
都怪洛玉青，青璇严重露出滔天杀意。
在这股杀意出现的霎那间，陆成脸色巨变，连忙向后倒退而去。
青璇看着陆成的反应，沉默片刻。
她通红的脸颊早已变得正常，很显然，那洛玉青留在她体内的剧毒通过与陆成的双修也彻底被陆成化解。
青璇再次深深的看了一眼陆成，然后转身，向宫殿外走去。
陆成看到青璇向宫殿外走去，他突然间眼神大变，猛然发现自己的修为竟然已经成功突破到筑基后期。
陆晨眼神露出惊喜的神色：这到底是怎么回事？为什么自己的境界突然间提高了两个境界，并且是由筑基中期提升到了筑基后期？难道是因为与清玄的双修吗？
陆晨陷入沉思。他伸出手看着手中的灵灵液，突然间明白了一切。他的修为为何突然暴涨，可能是与清玄的双修有关。难道是清玄的元婴之力吗？
陆晨眼中露出喜色。不过，他想起清玄方才眼中突然爆发出的杀意，以及最后深深看了他一眼后，眼中露出的复杂目光尘走出宫殿外面的大门后，回头看了一眼宫殿，内心陷入沉思，自从踏入这死亡禁地之后，这两个月发生了实在太多太多事情。
他没想，完全没有想到，这个死亡境界竟然是会是万年前实验中的遗址，而且他还没有想到，这个宫殿内竟然还活着一个万年前的人物，并且这个人物就是尸阴宗的宗主。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Mortal Cultivating Immortality: I Make the Cold Female Sect Master Full of Pregnancy! Chapter 86 Qingxuan leaves, Lu Cheng rescues Ling Xueyao (..la) The scene in the palace suddenly becomes indescribable!
The picture is simply too beautiful!
Lu Cheng looked at Qingxuan's scorching beautiful eyes and his head was steady.
What's going on?
Why did Qingxuan become like this?
Could it be the method Luo Yuqing left behind?
Lu Cheng felt a chill in his heart.
This Luo Yuqing is really cruel!
Suppress and seal Qingxuan for ten thousand years, destroy the Corpse Yin Sect, and take away the Corpse Yin Sect's sacred objects.
Now that Qingxuan has just escaped from trouble, she still uses such despicable methods. She is simply a beast!
And according to Luo Yuqing's description just now, Luo Yuqing deliberately placed the fragment of the third sister holding the Heavenly Cauldron here.
And also suppressed his lover.
Could it be that Luo Yuqing did all this on purpose?
Lu Cheng's eyes were cold.
But at this moment, he had no time to think about it, because Qingxuan's red lips were already printed on Lu Cheng's mouth.
Three hours later.
Qingxuan stared blankly at the sky, while Lu Cheng didn't dare to speak and put on his clothes carefully.
Qingxuan put on her clothes and looked at Lu Cheng with complicated eyes.
To kill or not to kill?
She was not at peace inside.
She had sworn a vow not long ago, but just now this junior had defiled her body.
But in the blink of an eye, I thought that I had taken the initiative.
It's all Luo Yuqing's fault, Qingxuan showed serious murderous intent.
The moment this killing intent appeared, Lu Cheng's expression changed drastically and he quickly stepped back.
Qingxuan looked at Lu Cheng's reaction and was silent for a moment.
Her red cheeks had long since become normal. It was obvious that the poison Luo Yuqing left in her body was completely resolved by Lu Cheng through his double cultivation.
Qingxuan took another deep look at Lu Cheng, then turned around and walked out of the palace.
When Lu Cheng saw Qingxuan walking outside the palace, his eyes suddenly changed, and he suddenly realized that his cultivation level had successfully broken through to the late stage of foundation building.
Lu Chen's eyes showed a look of surprise: What on earth is going on? Why did my realm suddenly increase by two realms, and from the middle stage of foundation establishment to the late stage of foundation establishment? Is it because of the dual cultivation with Qingxuan?
Lu Chen fell into deep thought. He stretched out his hand and looked at the spiritual liquid in his hand, and suddenly understood everything. Why his cultivation suddenly soared may be related to Qingxuan's dual cultivation. Could it be the power of Qingxuan's Nascent Soul?
Lu Chen's eyes showed joy. However, he remembered the sudden murderous intent in Qingxuan's eyes just now, and the complicated look in his eyes after taking a deep look at him at the end. After Chen walked out of the gate outside the palace, he looked back at the palace and fell into deep thought. Since he stepped into this forbidden land of death, too many things had happened in the past two months.
He never thought, never thought at all, that this realm of death would be the site of an experiment ten thousand years ago, and he had not thought that there was still a person from ten thousand years ago alive in this palace, and that this person was the leader of the Corpse Yin Sect.
